title: A Theoretical Framework for Statistical Evaluability of Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.05324v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Statistical evaluation aims to estimate the generalization performance of a model using held-out i.i.d. test data sampled from the ground-truth distribution. In supervised learning settings such as classification, performance metrics such as error rate are well-defined, and test error reliably approximates population error given sufficiently large datasets. In contrast, evaluation is more challenging for generative models due to their open-ended nature: it is unclear which metrics are appropriate and whether such metrics can be reliably evaluated from finite samples.   In this work, we introduce a theoretical framework for evaluating generative models and establish evaluability results for commonly used metrics. We study two categories of metrics: test-based metrics, including integral probability metrics (IPMs), and R\'enyi divergences. We show that IPMs with respect to any bounded test class can be evaluated from finite samples up

translated_title: 生成模型统计可评估性的理论框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.05324v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：统计评估旨在使用从真实分布中采样的独立同分布测试数据来估计模型的泛化性能。在诸如分类等监督学习场景中，错误率等性能指标定义明确，且当数据集足够大时，测试误差能可靠地近似总体误差。相比之下，生成模型的评估更具挑战性，因为其开放性特性：不清楚哪些指标适用，以及这些指标是否能从有限样本中可靠评估。在本工作中，我们引入了一个用于评估生成模型的理论框架，并为常用指标建立了可评估性结果。我们研究了两类指标：基于测试的指标，包括积分概率度量（IPMs）和Rényi散度。我们证明了相对于任何有界测试类的IPMs可以从有限样本中评估，直至某个误差范围。
tldr: 本文提出了一个理论框架，证明了生成模型中常用的积分概率度量和Rényi散度等指标可以从有限样本中可靠评估，解决了生成模型评估的开放性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a theoretical framework demonstrating that commonly used metrics like integral probability metrics and Rényi divergences in generative models can be reliably evaluated from finite samples, addressing the open-ended evaluation challenge.
